visual_description: A translucent plastic 'bell' hood attached to a segmented, flexible white arm. The arm is mounted to the ceiling and positioned directly over the TRX-07 jacket. A faint 'whirring' effect indicates high-speed suction. A small LED light ring is built into the rim of the hood to illuminate the work area.

constraints.logic: Must be active for any 'Pneumatic' task. Reduces 'Lab Cleaning' maintenance meter.
constraints.material: Polycarbonate hood; aluminum joints; wire-reinforced suction hose.
